name: Lionel Walker
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
life: “I still remember covering the night manager's desk on a school holiday.” On Thursday, near the window at Night Shift Donuts, Lionel knows when the going-home crowd and the coming-to-work crowd will both be there.
voice: I trained the night manager to cover for family emergencies. She wants the title as well as the work now.
appearance: Lionel is easy to recognize by dark brown curls cut close behind the ears and a wide brow and a narrow jaw. Usually dressed in an olive canvas jacket with a narrow brass watch set a little fast, Lionel counts on the side of one finger where hardly anybody notices when listening.
personality: Lionel enjoys bargaining, including over things already settled. It is partly a joke and partly a test of whether the other person feels able to say no.
agenda: To get the title and pay for night management.
family: Stefan Tate is Lionel’s first cousin once removed. At a family wedding the hired photographer missed the older relatives entirely. They assembled a second album from pictures taken over shoulders at the kitchen door. Lionel asks before bringing someone shy into the frame. Asked about *A wall of birthdays*, Stefan says, “I measured every child who lived here while their parents worked.”
connections: Riley Tate. A designer who once gave away a logo meets the manager asked to give away a title.
